name: Hoppscotch
summary: Hoppscotch is an open source API client that runs in the browser, on the desktop and from a CLI, and can be self-hosted. The Free plan covers collections, environments and the runner. Business costs $6 and Enterprise $11 per user a month, billed annually.

facts.text: The hopp test command runs a collection from the terminal and returns a non-zero exit code when an assertion fails.
The CLI can write a JUnit XML report and repeat a collection with rows from a CSV file.
Environments come in global, personal and shared types, and secret variables keep their values local and out of exports.
Hoppscotch can be used offline, self-hosted on premises, or in its cloud.
Collections can be imported and exported in Hoppscotch, OpenAPI and Postman formats.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Personal workspace, collections and environments, scripts and tests, collection runner, community support

plans.name: Business
plans.unit: per user per month, billed annually
